The '''Ooroo Canyon''' was a [[Mountain/Legends|canyon]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. Some distance from the western [[Eocho Mountains/Legends|Eocho Mountains]], the canyon was named after [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Ooroo/Legends|Ooroo]]. Circa [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]] the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] established the [[Great Jedi Library/Legends|Great Jedi Library]] on a mountain above the canyon, where it would stand for a millennium. Like many Jedi sites, Ooroo Canyon was painted with vivid murals and dotted with sculptures depicting great Jedi of the past.
